name: flaggems_batch_norm_no_update
description: Extracted from FlagGems _batch_norm_no_update. Inference-mode batch normalization (training=False) using running_mean/running_var. The pytest compares only the normalized output tensor against torch.nn.functional.batch_norm with float64-upcast reference inputs.
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    input_shape = list(ctx["input__shape"])
    input_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["input__dtype"])
    C = input_shape[1]
    out = {}
    out["input"] = torch.randn(input_shape, dtype=input_dtype, device=device)
    if "running_mean__shape" in ctx:
        rm_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["running_mean__dtype"])
        out["running_mean"] = torch.randn((C,), dtype=rm_dtype, device=device)
    if "running_var__shape" in ctx:
        rv_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["running_var__dtype"])
        out["running_var"] = (
            torch.abs(torch.randn((C,), dtype=rv_dtype, device=device)) + 0.1
        )
    if "weight__shape" in ctx:
        w_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["weight__dtype"])
        out["weight"] = torch.randn((C,), dtype=w_dtype, device=device)
    if "bias__shape" in ctx:
        b_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["bias__dtype"])
        out["bias"] = torch.randn((C,), dtype=b_dtype, device=device)
    return out


def run_correctness(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps):
    output = F.batch_norm(
        input.float(),
        running_mean.float(),
        running_var.float(),
        weight=weight.float() if weight is not None else None,
        bias=bias.float() if bias is not None else None,
        training=False,
        eps=eps,
    )
    return output.to(input.dtype)


def run(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps):
    return F.batch_norm(
        input,
        running_mean,
        running_var,
        weight=weight,
        bias=bias,
        training=False,
        eps=eps,
    )
